insights.title: Spending insights
insights.analysisTwo: {category} was the biggest at {amount}, then {nextCategory} at {nextAmount}.
insights.analysisNone: Nothing was spent in {month} — every entry that month was income.
insights.p.dining_out: Eating out came to {amount} over {count} visits. Cooking one of those at home instead would keep about {saving}.
insights.p.many_small: {category} was {count} separate entries for {amount} — about {average} each time.
insights.p.weekend: About {percent} of the month — {amount} over {count} entries — landed on a Saturday or a Sunday.
insights.p.idle_subscriptions: {count} subscriptions are still being paid for and not used: {amount} a month.
insights.basis.one: Based on the {count} transaction you logged in {month}.
insights.basis.other: Based on the {count} transactions you logged in {month}.
insights.estimateFood: The saving above is worked out at about {percent} of what you spent on food — planning arithmetic, not a promise.
insights.estimateWeekend: The weekend line only appears once about {threshold} of a month lands on a weekend.
insights.noPatterns: Nothing stands out this month — no pattern here is big enough to name.
insights.emptyBody: Nothing was logged in {month}, so there is no month to read. Add an entry, or pick another month.
qr.title: Scan a payment code
qr.cameraHint: Point the camera at the payment code. Nothing is paid until you press Pay.
qr.cameraUnsupported: This browser will not give a web page a camera, so there is nothing to scan from here. Paste the code below — it does exactly the same thing.
qr.cameraDenied: The camera permission was refused, so the camera is off. Paste the code below — it does exactly the same thing.
qr.cameraUnavailable: No camera could be started on this device. Paste the code below — it does exactly the same thing.
qr.codeHelp: Paste the whole code, including the part after the ?.
qr.rateReference: Reference rate for {when} — a dated table, not today's market price.
qr.nothingPaid: Nothing has been paid yet. Press Pay to record it.
qr.kept: The code's own {amount} {currency} is kept on the entry, with the rate and the day it was good for.
qr.belowZero: This payment has taken the balance below zero. The entry is recorded — the next income is what fixes it.
qr.categoryChosen: Nothing in the merchant's name matched a category, so this was filed under the one you use most. Change it on the entry if that is wrong.
